full_text:
Article 7 (Notification of Appointment of Data Provision Officer)
① The notification form for appointing a data provision officer, as stipulated in Article 12(2) of the "Enforcement Decree for the Act on the Promotion of Suicide Prevention and the Cultivation of a Culture of Respect for Life," shall be in the form specified in Appendix.
② The Minister of Health and Welfare, upon receiving the notification form as described in Article 1, shall verify the company registration certificate (if applicable) or business registration certificate (if applicable) through the joint use of administrative information as stipulated in Article 36(1) of the "Electronic Government Act." However, if the applicant does not consent to verifying the business registration certificate, a copy thereof shall be attached.
